title: Each plan's share of monthly paid revenue, 2025
prompt: For each plan, what share of that month's total paid invoice revenue did it represent, month by month across 2025? What grain do you need before you can compute a share of a total?
population: Paid invoices issued in 2025, joined through subscriptions to plans.
grain: Two stages: plan × month revenue, and month total (all-plans) revenue — final result at plan × month with a share-of-month column.
metricDefinition: plan_month_revenue / month_total_revenue, for each plan and month in 2025.
transformationPlan: aggregate paid invoices to plan × month revenue via subscriptions
aggregate plan × month revenue up to month totals
referenceSql: WITH plan_month AS (SELECT s.plan_id, date_trunc('month', i.issued_at) AS month, sum(i.amount) AS revenue FROM invoices i JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = i.subscription_id WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND i.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.plan_id, date_trunc('month', i.issued_at)), month_total AS (SELECT month, sum(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM plan_month GROUP BY month) SELECT pm.plan_id, pm.month, pm.revenue, pm.revenue / mt.total_revenue AS share_of_month FROM plan_month pm JOIN month_total mt ON mt.month = pm.month
